title: FlezerBoxes
description: A high-performance crates plugin featuring ultra-fast 2-turn animations, HEX-colored rarities, unique Rune mechanics, and interactive global broadcasts.
body:
🚀 Why FlezerBoxes?
Tired of slow, clunky crate opening animations? FlezerBoxes is designed for modern servers that value player time and visual style. Get a premium experience with unique features out of the box.

✨ Key Features:
⚡ Turbo Animation: A unique "Rocket Flare + 2 Quick Spins" animation. Fast, satisfying, and lag-free.

💎 WORLD Tier: Built-in support for a legendary rarity level with a stunning Pink-to-Red HEX gradient.

📢 Interactive Broadcasts: When a player wins a WORLD item, the whole server sees a clickable message. One click, and they are teleported to /warp boxs.

🔮 Rune System: Powerful magical runes with built-in NBT protection. Prevent players from placing them as blocks and use them for your server's economy.

🛠 Live GUI Editor: Edit loot tables, item weights (chances), and rarities directly in-game without touching config files.

🛡 NBT-Secure: All keys and runes are protected by unique metadata tags, making them impossible to forge.

🎮 Commands:
/boxs givekey <id> <rarity> <player> [amount] — Grant access to boxes.

/boxs giverunes <type> <player> <amount> — Issue magical runes.

/boxs setloot <id> <rarity> — Open the visual loot editor.

/boxs info <id> — Advanced box management dashboard.

🔧 Installation:
Drop the jar into your /plugins/ folder.

Restart your server.

Use /boxs create <name> to start building your first reward system!
